source_title: How Do I Refund A Transaction
snippet_primary:
> "In order to refund a customer, you'll want to log into your PayPal/Stripe account and find the user's details/transaction."

> "Please be aware that your refunds in PayPal/Stripe will also be reflected in Payhip. Since the refunded amount is taken into consideration in all places, the numbers shown on your monthly sales report and analytics will reflect that."
subject_exact: Payhip help center (help.payhip.com/article/147-how-do-i-refund-a-transaction, Apr 10, 2024) states refunds must be processed directly through the seller's PayPal or Stripe account; refunded amounts are automatically reflected in Payhip's monthly sales reports and analytics
local_qualifiers: Refunds issued through PayPal/Stripe directly; automatically synced to Payhip sales reports and analytics
parser_notes: help.payhip.com (Apr 10, 2024). Refunds via PayPal/Stripe; reflected in Payhip analytics.
